units.source_text: 另一边，两位武士四处打探无果，正垂头丧气的赶回京城。

en.t: Meanwhile, the two warriors had searched everywhere without success and were returning to the capital in low spirits.

units.source_text: 突然看到两位貌美如花的公主和貌似女子的年轻樵夫，

en.t: Suddenly they saw two princesses as beautiful as flowers and a young woodcutter who looked like a woman,

units.source_text: 一起骑在威风凛凛的黑狗背上，从天上直飞下来，

en.t: riding together on the back of a majestic black dog and flying straight down from the sky,
they were utterly astonished in their hearts.
